summary: Differs from checker.md 1.3.1 (ATIP feedback): L2.input-fragment names 'the same exit, ok, error.code and error.field'; differences() (input.rs:107) compares /ok, /error/code, masked /data and /meta/{command,output,warnings,fields} but never /error/field. Comparing it literally would be wrong for a refusal (spec 10.8: in a document the field is a pointer, in argv an option), so canon's omission is defensible; checker.md should say 'field after mapping an argument to its pointer', or drop it. Canon also compares four meta members the text does not name.
